description: This Java class 'ResultFactory' provides static factory methods for creating different types of 'Result' objects, including mutation results, error results, query results, and an empty result. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.persistentactors.results' package and utilizes external classes such as Command, Event, WithDittoHeaders, and various Result subclasses.

classes.name: ResultFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods to create various Result objects for different scenarios such as mutation, error, query, and empty results.

methods.name: newMutationResult
methods.description: Creates a mutation result with command, event, response, and optional flags for entity creation/deletion.

methods.name: newErrorResult
methods.description: Creates an error result based on a DittoRuntimeException and the command that caused it.

methods.name: newQueryResult
methods.description: Creates a query result with command and response.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty result.
